changeSet.sql: create or alter function [dbo].[UserAssetPermissionsByAssetID] ( @ResourceID int, @AssetTypeID int, @AssetID bigint ) returns table as return ( select [Permissions] as PermissionsBitMask, AssetID, AssetTypeID from dbo.ResponsibilitySummary where AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID and AssetID = @AssetID and ResourceID = @ResourceID and ApplyToType = 0 union all select [Permissions] as PermissionsBitMask, A.ID as AssetID, A.AssetTypeID from dbo.ResponsibilitySummary S inner join dbo.Asset A on A.AssetTypeID = S.AssetTypeID and A.AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID and S.AssetID = 0 and S.ResourceID = @ResourceID and S.ApplyToType = 1 union all select A.PermissionsBitMask, A.AssetID, A.AssetTypeID from dbo.AssetType T cross apply ( select ResourceID, IsAdministrator from reporting.Global_Resource where ResourceID = @ResourceID and IsAdministrator = 0 ) R cross apply GetAssetsOfDefaultPermissionsAssetID(@ResourceID, @AssetTypeID, T.DefaultPermissions, R.IsAdministrator, 0, @AssetID) A where A.AssetID = @AssetID and T.ID = @AssetTypeID and T.DefaultPermissions = 0 )
